shortDescription: Configures which proxy server to use for the specified protocol

options.name: config
options.description: Proxy configuration for the specific protocol. Required with I(state=['test']) Valid attributes are:  - C(server) (str): URL of the proxy server (['test'])    This key is required with ['test'].  - C(port) (int): Port to connect to the proxy server. In a 'get' call, indicates the port connected to the proxy server. In a 'set' call, specifies the port to connect to the proxy server. A value of -1 indicates the default port. (['test'])    This key is required with ['test'].  - C(username) (str): U

options.name: enabled
options.description: In the result of the #get and #list operations this field indicates whether proxying is enabled for a particular protocol. In the input to the test and set operations this field specifies whether proxying should be enabled for a particular protocol. Required with I(state=['set'])

options.name: host
options.description: A hostname, IPv4 or Ipv6 address. Required with I(state=['test'])

options.name: password
options.description: Password for proxy server. Only set if proxy requires password.

options.name: port
options.description: Port to connect to the proxy server. In a 'get' call, indicates the port connected to the proxy server. In a 'set' call, specifies the port to connect to the proxy server. A value of -1 indicates the default port. Required with I(state=['set'])

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol for which proxy should be set. This parameter is mandatory.

options.name: server
options.description: URL of the proxy server Required with I(state=['set'])

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: Timeout settings for client session.  The maximal number of seconds for the whole operation including connection establishment, request sending and response.  The default value is 300s.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for proxy server. Only set if proxy requires username.

options.name: vcenter_hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_password
options.description: The vSphere vCenter password If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_rest_log_file
options.description: You can use this optional parameter to set the location of a log file.  This file will be used to record the HTTP REST interaction.  The file will be stored on the host that runs the module.  If the value is not specified in the task, the value of  environment variable C(VMWARE_REST_LOG_FILE) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: The vSphere vCenter username If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to C(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
